Its blade appears only when drawn, and its cutting power surpasses metal swords.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Name Ref|SSBU}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 40 |durability = 54 |flammable = No |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = Yes |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Ancient Short Sword}} Ancient Short Swords can be made by supplying the [[Ancient Oven]] at the [[Akkala Ancient Tech Lab]] with 1,000 [[Rupee]]s, 15 [[Ancient Spring]]s, 5 [[Ancient Shaft]]s, and 2 [[Ancient Core]]s.{{Cite|Exchange for Ancient Short Sword?|Ancient Oven|BotW}} Their blades are made using [[Ancient Technology]], only appearing when the [[Weapon]]s are drawn. The cutting power of Ancient Short Swords is stronger than any metal swords. They belong to the [[Ancient Soldier Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all Weapons created by [[Robbie]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 175}} The final Weapon that [[Nebb]] will ask [[Link]] to show him during "[[The Weapon Connoisseur]]" [[Side Quest]] is an Ancient Short Sword, which he claims are not common around [[Hateno Village]].{{Cite|So, have you heard of the {{Color BotW|Blue|ancient short sword}}? Grandpa said you can't find those around here. If you get ahold of one, let me see it!|Nebb|BotW}} If Link brings an Ancient Short Sword for Nebb to see, Nebb will become excited and give him a [[Diamond]] as a reward.{{Cite|Isn't that...the {{Color BotW|Blue|ancient short sword}}? Nice! Nice! Let me see, let me see!|Nebb|BotW}}{{Cite|Thank you! Take this as a token of my thanks!|Nebb|BotW}} Ancient Short Swords are made from Ancient Technology, and therefore they will deal a higher amount of damage against [[Guardian]]-type [[Enemy|Enemies]]. They will not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]]. However, they are capable of floating on [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], are unable to burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], and cannot be manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_023" |Life = 54 |Power = 40 |SpHitActor = Actors with tags "TeamGuardian", "IsEffectiveAncientWeapon"; "Enemy_Ganon", "Enemy_SiteBoss_", "Enemy_Guardian_Mini_" {{List Note|All Guardians and Guardian Scouts, Calamity Ganon and Dark Beast Ganon, All Ganon Blights, Guardian legs/propellers}} |SpHitRatio = 1.5 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 7 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 14 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 11 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 15 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 27 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 12 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 27 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 5 |BuyingPrice = 20 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{SSBU|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|SSBU}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== * An unused icon and description for Ancient Short Swords exist within the files of {{AoC}}.{{Cite Internal|quote= The blade of this sword was made using an ancient power lost to this modern age.
